card.name: Newborn withdrawal-sign wording
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "for" or "include" right after newborn or neonate, in label text about opioid withdrawal in newborns, just before a list of signs.

modes.label: Observe newborns for
modes.description: The word "for" right after "Observe newborns" in neonatal opioid withdrawal warnings.
modes.example: Observe newborns<< for>> signs of neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome and

modes.label: Neonate withdrawal list
modes.description: The word "include" or the colon after "In the neonate, opioid withdrawal may also", leading into a list of signs.
modes.example: In the neonate, opioid withdrawal may also<< include>>: convulsions, excessive crying,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about babies and infants, such as baby, infants and breastfeeding.
card.plain: It fires on small words in newborn withdrawal warnings, where the next words will likely refer to babies.
